observations.why: Imperative directive performing a settled instruction the speaker expects compliance with — decision-grade by its performed act, not a notion or claim.
Operational imperative with 'all' scoping — a performed declarative instructing removal, settling the matter as a decision the speaker expects acted on.
Flat unhedged assertive stated as fact; no ratification or operational language lifts it to decision, and no permanence or identity language raises it to principle.
